steps: Sign up at prolific.com and verify your identity.
Complete the 'About You' demographic profile to unlock studies.
Accept studies from your dashboard (estimated $/hr shown before you start).
Complete the study; researcher approves (usually within days).
Cash out to PayPal once your balance reaches $6/£6 (instant after your first 4 cashouts).
timing: Researcher approval usually within days; PayPal cashout from $6/£6, instant after the first 4 cashouts.

repeatable.cadence: new studies post to your dashboard throughout the day — you can take each one you’re eligible for until slots fill

maximize: Fill out your full Prolific profile and prescreening questions so researchers can match you to more studies. Keep study alerts on and respond fast — slots fill in seconds. Complete every study carefully; a clean approval record gets you allocated more studies, and each completed study pays at least $8/hour with researcher approval usually within days. Cash out to PayPal once you hit the $6/£6 balance — payouts are instant after your first four cashouts.
who_pays: Prolific pays you directly — your earnings build as cash in your Prolific account, and you cash out to your own PayPal. Always cash, never gift cards or points, with no withdrawal fees.
who_qualifies: 18+ with a PayPal account in your name and completed identity verification. US/UK/EU residents see the most studies.
work_available: Open marketplace, but fast-moving and demographic-dependent — studies fill in seconds, US/UK/EU get the most, and new users often see few studies at first. Check frequently or use a notifier.
what_gets_accepted: The researcher must approve your submission before the reward credits — usually within days. Careful, honest, complete work keeps your approval record clean and unlocks more studies.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no fees. Unpaid time: completing the ‘About You’ demographic profile and prescreening questions to unlock studies, plus time checking for slots.
when_cash_arrives: After researcher approval (usually within days), cash out to PayPal once your balance reaches $6/£6 — instant after your first 4 cashouts, which are processed manually.
